seo.metaTitle: eCom Gliders Privacy Policy | Data Practices
seo.metaDescription: eCom Gliders Privacy Policy: how we collect, use, share, and protect personal and business information when you visit our website or work with our Amazon agency team.

intro: eCom Gliders LLC ("eCom Gliders," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when we share it, and the choices available to you when you visit ecomgliders.com, submit a form, or engage our Amazon agency services.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to information we collect from website visitors, prospective clients, and current clients through our website, email, phone, and service engagements. It covers situations where eCom Gliders decides how and why personal information is used.

When we manage advertising, listings, or account data inside a client's Amazon Seller Central or Ads account, we typically process that information as a service provider under the client's direction. For questions about Amazon account data controlled by a brand, contact that brand or Amazon directly as well as our team where appropriate.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information in three main ways: what you provide directly, what is collected automatically on our website, and what you share so we can deliver services.

sections.heading: 2.1 Information you provide
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with us, this may include:
bullets: Contact details such as name, email address, phone number, company name, and job title
Messages and form submissions from contact, free-audit, or service inquiry forms
Billing and invoicing details needed to issue invoices or process payments (card numbers are handled by Stripe; we do not store full payment card numbers on our systems)
Business information you choose to share for service delivery, such as Amazon storefront URLs, ASINs, advertising accounts, listing content, catalogs, and performance metrics

sections.heading: 2.2 Information collected automatically
paragraphs: When you visit our website, we and our service providers may collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, device and operating system information, referring URL, pages viewed, and approximate location derived from IP address. We may also use cookies and similar technologies as described below.

sections.heading: 2.3 Information from service work
paragraphs: To deliver Amazon-related services, you may grant us access to Seller Central, Amazon Ads, or related tools. Through that access we may view and process account, advertising, listing, inventory, and performance data needed to perform the agreed work. We use that access only to provide services for your account unless you authorize another use in writing.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Operate the website and respond to inquiries, audits, and support requests
Provide, manage, and improve Amazon agency services (including PPC, listings, creative, catalog, and related account work)
Communicate about projects, invoices, scheduling, and operational updates
Send marketing or newsletter messages where permitted (you may unsubscribe at any time)
Analyze website and service performance so we can improve content and delivery
Detect, prevent, or investigate fraud, abuse, or security issues
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements and policies

sections.heading: 4. How we share information
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or business information. We share information only as needed to run our business and deliver services, including:
bullets: Service providers that support hosting, analytics, email, forms, invoicing, and payments (for example Stripe for payment processing)
Specialists on our team or contracted support who need access to deliver your engagement, under confidentiality expectations
Professional advisors (such as legal or accounting) when reasonably required
Authorities when required by law, court order, or to protect rights, safety, or security
A successor entity in connection with a merger, acquisition, or similar corporate transaction, subject to continued protection of the information
Other parties when you give us permission to share

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to operate the site, remember preferences, measure traffic, and improve content. Categories may include essential cookies needed for basic functionality, analytics cookies that help us understand site usage, and optional marketing cookies if we run advertising or remarketing.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may limit how the site works. Where a cookie consent tool is available on the site, you can also update preferences there.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: We keep information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, including to provide services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, and meet legal, tax, or accounting requirements. Retention periods vary by record type. When information is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it where reasonably practicable.

sections.heading: 7. Security
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. Please use strong unique passwords for shared tools and notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access to accounts we use together.

sections.heading: 8. Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct inaccurate information, request deletion, or ask us to limit certain processing. You may also withdraw marketing consent at any time.

To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding. Some requests may be limited by legal or contractual obligations, including records we must keep for active service or compliance.

sections.heading: 9. Children's privacy
paragraphs: Our website and services are directed to businesses and professionals. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Third-party websites and platforms
paragraphs: Our site may link to third-party websites or platforms, including Amazon, payment processors, and social networks. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies. We are not responsible for the content or practices of sites we do not control.

sections.heading: 11. International visitors
paragraphs: eCom Gliders is based in the United States. If you access our website or services from outside the United States, you understand that information may be processed in the United States and other locations where we or our service providers operate.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The effective date at the top of this page will change when we post updates. Continued use of the website or services after an update means you acknowledge the revised policy. For material changes that affect active client engagements, we may also provide additional notice where appropriate.

sections.heading: 13. Contact us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle information, contact eCom Gliders using the details below.
